name: 55311 · Maple Grove, MN
findings: ZIP 55311 (Maple Grove) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55311 (Maple Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
